name: Wallpaper Ease Slideshow
description: GPU-composited, iOS-style ease-in-out wallpaper crossfade at full frame rate. Drives the desktop background from a JSON playlist produced by the gnome-wallpaper-slideshow generator, using two Meta.Background actors and Clutter EASE_IN_OUT_CUBIC. Replaces GNOME 42's native 1 Hz linear slideshow transition; the native slideshow still backs the lock screen and is the fallback when this extension is disabled.
